examples.en: The impressive promise was smoke and mirrors.
examples.zh: 那項看似吸引的承諾只是一場障眼法。

examples.en: The sudden improvement is smoke and mirrors.
examples.zh: 這項突然出現的改善只是虛假包裝。

meaning.en: Smoke and mirrors refers to misleading words, impressive appearances or clever actions used to hide the truth or make something seem better, more successful or more real than it actually is.
meaning.zh: Smoke and mirrors 指利用誤導性說法、表面功夫或巧妙手段掩蓋真相，令某件事看起來比實際上更好、更成功或更真實。
naturalZh: Smoke and mirrors 指利用誤導性說法、表面功夫或巧妙手段掩蓋真相，令某件事看起來比實際上更好、更成功或更真實。

register.summaryEn: Cambridge and Collins label the expression mainly American, although it is also established and readily understood in British English. The expression usually carries criticism, doubt or accusation. 性語域,常見於日常對話、新聞評論、商業評論、廣告分析、產品評論及較輕鬆的工作 交流。
register.summaryZh: 使用這個表達可能會令人感到你在指責對方有意誤導。 因此，不應只因自己不完全明白某項解釋便使用它。
register.formalEn: conversation; journalism; political or business commentary; reviews; discussions of advertising; workplace criticism; informal reports or presentations.
register.formalZh: 使用這個表達可能會令人感到你在指責對方有意誤導。 因此，不應只因自己不完全明白某項解釋便使用它。

specificForms.descriptionZh: 這是最常見的句式之一。 主語通常是受到批評的說法、外表、承諾、計劃或表面改善。

specificForms.formula: Subject + be + all / just / mostly / merely / nothing but / little more than + smoke and mirrors.
specificForms.descriptionEn: all smoke and mirrors: entirely deceptive; mostly smoke and mirrors: mainly deceptive, but perhaps not completely; little more than smoke and mirrors: contains very little real value; nothing but smoke and mirrors: entirely without substance.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這些字詞會改變批評的強度，因此必須保留原句的程度。

examples.en: The supposed improvement was little more than smoke and mirrors.

examples.en: Even allowing for the smoke and mirrors, one part of the offer was useful.
examples.zh: 即使考慮到其中的虛假包裝，這項優惠仍有一部分是有用的。

benefits.en: The expression clearly communicates that something looks impressive or convincing but lacks real substance.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以清楚說明某件事表面上令人信服，但實際上缺乏真正內容。 這項計劃只是一場障眼法。

examples.en: The plan is smoke and mirrors.
examples.zh: 這項計劃只是一場障眼法。

benefits.zh: 公司以障眼法把差劣成果包裝成成功。

benefits.en: With may, might, could, seem or appear, speakers can question a claim without presenting their suspicion as a proven fact.
benefits.zh: 那些亮眼數字可能只是障眼法。 配合 may、might、could、seem 或 appear，說話者可以質疑一項說法，而不會把懷疑說成已證實的事實。

examples.en: The impressive figures may be smoke and mirrors.
examples.zh: 那些亮眼數字可能只是障眼法。

benefits.en: Verbs such as see through, look past and cut through allow speakers to focus on discovering the truth.
benefits.zh: 及 cut through 等動詞可以突出識破表面把戲、了解真相的過程。

benefits.titleEn: It Works in Several Grammatical Positions
benefits.en: It Works in Several Grammatical Positions

benefits.titleEn: It Can Also Praise Honesty Through Contrast
benefits.titleZh: 亦可透過對比稱讚誠實
benefits.en: The negative or absence forms allow speakers to say that an explanation is direct, honest and transparent. Model 1: Predicative Form The company made its results look much better than they really were by showing only its strongest month. Model 2: Object Form with an Optional Method Phrase The seller hid the extra charges in small print to make the offer appear cheaper.
benefits.zh: 報告沒有任何故弄玄虛的內容。 Model Examples 示範例子例子一：表語形式公司只展示表現最好的一個月，令整體成績看起來遠比實際出色。 公司的亮眼成績只是以表現最好的一個月製造出來的虛假包裝。 例子二：受詞形式及可選的方式短語賣家把額外收費藏在細小文字中，令優惠看起來較便宜。 賣家把額外收費藏在細小文字中，以障眼法令優惠看起來較便宜。

examples.en: The report was free of smoke and mirrors.
examples.zh: 報告沒有任何故弄玄虛的內容。

examples.en: The company’s impressive results were smoke and mirrors based on its strongest month.
examples.zh: 公司的亮眼成績只是以表現最好的一個月製造出來的虛假包裝。

examples.en: The seller used smoke and mirrors by hiding the extra charges in small print.
examples.zh: 賣家把額外收費藏在細小文字中，以障眼法令優惠看起來較便宜。

origin.statusEn: Most Likely Development; Exact First Use Uncertain
origin.statusZh: 最可能的演變；確切首次用法不明

history.en: The literal tools of stage illusion became a metaphor for incomplete figures, impressive appearances and distracting explanations. Merriam-Webster dates its earliest known use of the
history.zh: 逐漸成為比喻，用來形容不完整的數字、令人分心的解釋及只有表面效果的包裝。 現有字典一般把現代說法的出現時間定於二十世紀後期，但確切首次用法仍可能有待更多歷史資料確認。

origin.memoryEn: Smoke blocks your view, and mirrors change what you see; smoke and mirrors hides the truth and presents an illusion.
origin.memoryZh: 煙霧阻擋視線，鏡子改變所見畫面；smoke and mirrors 因而表示掩蓋真相、製造假象。

rules.titleZh: 規則一：固定字詞不可改變

rules.titleEn: Do Not Add “A” Directly Before the Noun Phrase
rules.titleZh: 規則二：不要直接在名詞短語前加入 a
rules.en: Do Not Add “A” Directly Before the Noun Phrase
rules.zh: 這是一項掩人耳目的手段。 這是一場故弄玄虛的表演。

examples.en: It was a smoke-and-mirrors tactic.
examples.zh: 這是一項掩人耳目的手段。

examples.en: It was a display of smoke and mirrors.
examples.zh: 這是一場故弄玄虛的表演。

rules.titleZh: 規則三：放在另一個名詞前時使用連字號
rules.zh: 放在另一個名詞前時使用連字號

rules.en: The incorrect answer changes suspicion into certainty.
rules.zh: 錯誤答案把懷疑改成了確定事實。

rules.titleEn: Use It Only When Deception or Misdirection Is Present
rules.titleZh: 規則六：只有存在欺騙或轉移注意時才使用
rules.en: A difficult report is not necessarily deceptive.
rules.zh: 一份報告難以理解，並不代表它必定有意誤導。

rules.titleZh: 規則七：保留被隱瞞的實際情況
rules.en: The weak answer loses the specific method and the fact that the rooms were small.
rules.zh: 較弱的答案刪除了具體手段，也沒有保留房間實際上很小這項重要資料。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Repeat the Idiom’s Meaning
rules.titleZh: 規則八：使用慣用語後不要重複相同意思
rules.en: The second clause supplies the specific hidden fact rather than defining the idiom again.
rules.zh: 那項承諾只是一場障眼法； 公司根本沒有可用的產品。 第二個分句補充具體真相，而不是再次解釋慣用語的意思。

examples.en: The promise was smoke and mirrors; the company had no working product.
examples.zh: 那項承諾只是一場障眼法；公司根本沒有可用的產品。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Treat Every Advertisement as Smoke and Mirrors
rules.titleZh: 規則九：不要把所有廣告都稱為障眼法
rules.en: Advertising becomes smoke and mirrors only when it seriously misleads, hides essential information or creates a false impression.
rules.zh: 只有當廣告嚴重誤導、隱瞞重要資料或製造虛假印象時，才適合使用這個表達。

rules.titleEn: Be Aware of the Accusatory Tone
rules.titleZh: 規則十：留意其指責語氣
rules.en: You may be deliberately hiding or changing the truth.
rules.zh: 這句並不只是表示對方的解釋不清楚，而是暗示對方可能有意隱瞞或歪曲真相。

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to each item using smoke and mirrors.
instructions.zh: 使用 smoke and mirrors 改寫句子或完成回應。

questions.prompt: The new app looks impressive, but most of its advertised functions do not actually work.
questions.promptZh: 這個新應用程式看起來十分出色，但廣告中大部分功能實際上都不能使用。
questions.answer: The new app is mostly smoke and mirrors because most of its advertised functions do not work.
questions.answerZh: 這個新應用程式大部分只是虛假包裝，因為廣告中的大部分功能都不能使用。
questions.targetMeaning: Smoke and mirrors refers to misleading words, impressive appearances or clever actions used to hide the truth or make something seem better, more successful or more real than it actually is.

questions.promptZh: 店舖宣傳大幅減價，但它事前已先提高原價。

questions.targetMeaning: Smoke and mirrors refers to misleading words, impressive appearances or clever actions used to hide the truth or make something seem better, more successful or more real than it actually is.

questions.answer: The colourful report was all smoke and mirrors; almost nothing had actually improved.
questions.answerZh: 那份色彩鮮明的報告全是表面功夫，實際上幾乎沒有任何改善。
questions.targetMeaning: Smoke and mirrors refers to misleading words, impressive appearances or clever actions used to hide the truth or make something seem better, more successful or more real than it actually is.

questions.promptZh: 她只展示經過精心挑選的照片，令網上生活看起來十分完美。
questions.answer: Her perfect online life was smoke and mirrors created through carefully selected photographs.
questions.answerZh: 她完美的網上生活，只是透過精心挑選照片製造的假象。
questions.targetMeaning: Smoke and mirrors refers to misleading words, impressive appearances or clever actions used to hide the truth or make something seem better, more successful or more real than it actually is.

questions.prompt: The product box looked large, but most of the space inside it was empty.
questions.promptZh: 產品包裝盒看起來很大，但內部大部分空間都是空的。
questions.answer: The large-looking package was smoke and mirrors; most of the box was empty.
questions.answerZh: 那個看似大型的包裝盒只是一場障眼法，盒內大部分空間都是空的。
questions.targetMeaning: Smoke and mirrors refers to misleading words, impressive appearances or clever actions used to hide the truth or make something seem better, more successful or more real than it actually is.

questions.prompt: The club promised ten new events, although it had actually planned only one.
questions.promptZh: 學會承諾舉辦十項新活動，但實際上只計劃了一項。
questions.answer: The club’s promise of ten new events was little more than smoke and mirrors; only one had been planned.
questions.answerZh: 學會承諾舉辦十項新活動，幾乎只是一場障眼法，因為實際上只計劃了一項。
questions.targetMeaning: Smoke and mirrors refers to misleading words, impressive appearances or clever actions used to hide the truth or make something seem better, more successful or more real than it actually is.

questions.promptZh: 公司聲稱投訴數量下降，但它其實只是從網站移除了投訴表格。
questions.answer: The claimed fall in complaints was smoke and mirrors: the company had simply removed the complaint form.
questions.answerZh: 所謂投訴數量下降只是一場障眼法；公司只是移除了投訴表格。
questions.targetMeaning: Smoke and mirrors refers to misleading words, impressive appearances or clever actions used to hide the truth or make something seem better, more successful or more real than it actually is.

questions.promptZh: 酒店使用廣角鏡頭，令細小的房間看起來大得多。

questions.answerZh: 酒店使用廣角鏡頭拍攝細小房間，以障眼法令房間看起來大得多。
questions.targetMeaning: Smoke and mirrors refers to misleading words, impressive appearances or clever actions used to hide the truth or make something seem better, more successful or more real than it actually is.

questions.answer: The course advert was nothing but smoke and mirrors; its lessons had been copied from free online videos.
questions.answerZh: 課程廣告完全是虛假包裝，因為課堂內容都是從免費網上影片抄來的。
questions.targetMeaning: Smoke and mirrors refers to misleading words, impressive appearances or clever actions used to hide the truth or make something seem better, more successful or more real than it actually is.

questions.answerZh: 公司的環保宣傳只是一場障眼法，因為改變的只有包裝顏色。
questions.targetMeaning: Smoke and mirrors refers to misleading words, impressive appearances or clever actions used to hide the truth or make something seem better, more successful or more real than it actually is.

questions.prompt: Nobody has checked whether the company’s unusually high figures are genuine, so they may be misleading.

questions.answer: The company’s unusually high figures may be smoke and mirrors.
questions.answerZh: 公司異常高的數字可能只是障眼法。
questions.targetMeaning: Smoke and mirrors refers to misleading words, impressive appearances or clever actions used to hide the truth or make something seem better, more successful or more real than it actually is.

questions.promptZh: 這項計劃看起來十分詳細，但當中沒有日期、成本或明確行動。
questions.answer: The detailed-looking plan appears to be smoke and mirrors because it contains no dates, costs or clear actions.

questions.targetMeaning: Smoke and mirrors refers to misleading words, impressive appearances or clever actions used to hide the truth or make something seem better, more successful or more real than it actually is.

questions.promptZh: 新預算十分誠實，並清楚列出每一項開支。
questions.answer: The new budget is not smoke and mirrors; every item of spending is clearly shown.
questions.answerZh: 新預算並不是障眼法；每一項開支均有清楚列出。
questions.targetMeaning: Smoke and mirrors refers to misleading words, impressive appearances or clever actions used to hide the truth or make something seem better, more successful or more real than it actually is.

questions.prompt: The inventor tested the product live and allowed everyone to examine it closely.
